figurative_meaning_en: The instigator of evil or mischief
example_sentences_in_bangla: তুমি সব নষ্টের গোড়া, তোমার কারণেই এই ঝামেলা হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: You are the root of all mischief; it's because of you that this trouble happened.
That man is the source of all evil in the village.
note: This idiom is commonly used in colloquial Bengali to blame someone for causing problems.
